output.description: Absolute path: the file, or the folder of an image sequence.

codec.description: The codec, or null for an image sequence.

durationMs.description: Time spent rendering and encoding, from the first frame to the written file.

totalMs.description: Time the whole command took, bundling and opening the browser included.

ffmpeg.description: The FFmpeg that encoded the video (D-065). Absent for image sequences, which do not run FFmpeg.

version.description: As FFmpeg prints it; null when it could not be read.

source.description: MOTIO_FFMPEG (env), the pinned build of @motiojs/ffmpeg (package) or PATH.

build.description: Build number of the pinned build, when source is package.

fallback.description: Set when the pinned build of @motiojs/ffmpeg could not be used (archives not published, offline) and the FFmpeg on PATH was used instead.

code.description: The error code that made the pinned build unusable.

sequence.description: Present when the output is an image sequence folder.

imageFormat.description: Image format of an image sequence.
